description.zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

重置访问控制策略时，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用[DescribeVpcFirewallControlPolicy](~~159758~~)接口获取该ID。
description.en:
The unique ID of the access control policy.

To reset the hit count of an access control policy, specify the unique ID of the policy. You can call the [DescribeVpcFirewallControlPolicy](~~159758~~) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language of the request and response.

Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

title.zh: 将VPC防火墙问控制策略命中计数清零

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于将指定的VPC防火墙策略组访问控制策略的命中计数清零。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation resets the hit count of a specific access control policy in a VPC firewall policy group to zero.

## QPS limit

This operation has a queries per second (QPS) limit of 10 per user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at a reasonable rate.
